reviewer: Actually opened and visually inspected every individual original PNG for indices 35-51, used source pages 9-13 for enlarged comparison, and actually viewed mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png. Compared each source's visible headgear, hair, facial hair, eyewear, clothing, pose, lighting and card backing with the smooth compact yellow mascot's green-ringed black eyes and small mouth; these prompts use visible evidence rather than filenames.

entries.background_prompt: Transparent exterior surrounds the real tilted dark photo frame and overlapping cream note.
